steps.content:
22:30, February 3, N.F. 114.
Minos Bureau of Crisis Control.

Cradling the bow, Yanyan curls up in a corner of the room. She wraps the carving knife with her special ability, engraving the bow body bit by bit while filling the patterns with small flames. Apparently, this is how the sorcery works.
Since having gathered all the materials for the Almighty Bow, she has maintained this posture without ever getting up.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: It's okay. It will work... Everything's gonna be fine.
Eyes shadowed by heavy dark circles, she mumbles to herself as her hands continue the bow-crafting process mechanically.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You're pushing yourself too hard, you'll be exhausted before the sun shot. The FAC hasn't localized the Sun Crow yet, we still have time.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Only a little bit more to go. It's almost done. There will be no problems... I can't, make mistakes again...
Not noticing your approach, she keeps working without looking up, her hands moving faster and faster. Finally...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Ah!
In her haste, the carving knife cuts Yanyan's finger, and blood drops onto the bow. She quickly pulls up her sleeve to wipe it.
She keeps wiping and wiping, as if the stained spot could never be cleaned.
You take the bow wordlessly and make a show of wiping it a few times before setting it aside. Then, you grab Yanyan's hand to check the wound.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Oh, look how clumsy I am... I've only got one final step left but I can't even do the engraving properly. How can I be a great seer like this...
She tries to shrug it off, but her shoulders remain drooped and she bows her head low to avoid your gaze. You both plunge into a brief silence.
Finally, she speaks first.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: You know, Chief, I'm actually very afraid of natural disasters. When I was a child, the great drought brought by the Sun Crow dried up the fields, and its little monsters hurt people everywhere... I still remember how Grandma's house was set ablaze. It was terrifying...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: But back then, there was a very powerful seer in Sunset Town. The Great Seer was a wonderful person. She could always predict when disasters would come. She was always fighting against natural disasters and protecting us, warding off evil spirits.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: When Grandma and I were struggling to survive, she led us to our new shelter with her divination and performed a ritual dance to bless us. She told Grandma and I and everyone that we would all see the most beautiful sunset.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: The Great Seer kept her promise. She was so powerful and reassuring, always inspiring everyone with her smile. Everyone trusted her fully. In the end, she led us to shoot down the Sun Crow.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I too wish to stop disasters like the Great Seer. I want to tell Grandma, my fellow townspeople victimized by disasters, and everyone who is scared like me, that everything will be alright, because the seer is here.
The Fusang Branch, the String of East Sea, and the Mystic Fletching. Yanyan looks at these symbols laden with great wishes and bows her head lower and lower.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ...But Yanyan can't do it as well.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: My channeling skills aren't strong enough. I often misinterpret the Wraith Spirits. I haven't read enough scriptures. I don't know the oracles by heart. I even made a fool of myself.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I know the people of DisCity don't believe in Yanyan. Those myths sounded so captivating in the Great Seer's words, but they become foolish coming from me... I've been nothing but trouble on our journey to gather materials.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: The Great Seer is no longer with us. She left the human realm which she painstakingly guarded in my care. What if I can't protect it... What if the disasters return, what then...
She hugs the unfinished bow and arrow dejectedly, too guilty to meet your eyes.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've done very well already. You deciphered the myth and gathered all the materials for the Almighty Bow in just a few days. It's proof that you're more than capable. We all support you.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: That's because Chief and many others helped me. And yet, I was still distracted by evil spirits.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: There are many good people here too. If I fail, I'll let you all down as well...
Before you can say anything more, a faint foreign fragrance drifts by as Du Ruo walks past you and approaches Yanyan.
She gently takes Yanyan's injured hand that you're gripping. A smoke brushes over the wound and heals it.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ...Du Ruo? Ouch! Ouch...
Before Yanyan finishes her sentence, Du Ruo knocks her forehead hard with her knuckles, an elegant and charming smile still on her face. Watching this, you instinctively shut your mouth.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Oh dear, it seems like Yanyan's little brain is getting confused from too much sleep. Overthinking is an illness. I must help you cure it.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Having spent so much time in Sunset Town, I know for a fact that there wasn't any so-called flawless Great Seer. It's about time I expose her other side.
Du Ruo casually picks up the brush and ink on the desk...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: W-what?! ...What is this?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: The first attempt at the Almighty Bow by that Great Seer, but it's nowhere near as good as yours.

options: Or maybe you just can't draw?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Are you questioning a cultured scholar's art skills, Chief?
She gives you a smile, but the smoke around her cools by a few degrees.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: If you had seen her actual carvings, you would only marvel at how lifelike my drawing is. It's my personal touch that gave the Almighty Bow its elegant and majestic design.

options: Of course, the great scholar is always right.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ...Pfft.
Yanyan can't help but laugh at your banter, and then quickly tries to compose herself. Du Ruo bends down and hands over the comical drawing to Yanyan seriously.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Stop frowning. Yanyan, you did very well. You are not lesser than your predecessor.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Oh, and let me tell you a secret. "The Great Seer" couldn't even swim at your age, and she nearly drowned herself once.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: No way! Really? Even I can...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ...No, I don't believe it. Chief said Du Ruo is a liar.
Before Du Ruo turns to you, you quickly look away to avoid her gaze.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I've seen the power of the Great Seer myself. That's the power that created the Almighty Bow and defeated the Sun Crow. She was not as weak as you made it sound like, unlike me...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: She was no different than you. That fool also had to work hard to look cool in front of you.
Though Du Ruo's tone is mocking, her expression softens a bit.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: She traveled, studied, practiced, faced doubts, asked stupid questions, and got back up every time she fell. That's how she became skillful in channeling, saw through the unknown, and lent her force to the people.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: To combat the aquatic dragon, she spent three months practicing in the lake. She finally learned how to swim when she choked on water for the umpteenth time.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Now, do you still think the Great Seer is untouchable?
Yanyan looks up at Du Ruo, her eyes filled with curiosity, surprise, and confusion.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: ...Um, regardless, Yanyan's ultimate enemy is the Sun Crow. I know how terrifying that creature is. Can I really do it in so little time...

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Of course not, if you try to do it all by yourself.
Yanyan looks puzzled as Du Ruo knocks her on the forehead again.

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: The Sun Shot wasn't the effort of a single person, but one with the support of many people. The seer gathered everyone's strength to accomplish the feat of shooting down the suns.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: Where can I find these people?

steps.speaker: Du Ruo
steps.content: Why don't you take a look behind you?
[Chief's portrait]
It's a bit sudden. Yanyan still seems confused when she looks at you, but Du Ruo's smile already tells you what to do.

options: Let me take you to meet them.

steps.content: You take Yanyan's hand and walk out of the break room. In the MBCC's narrow corridor, Nightingale and the FAC soldiers are on standby.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier A
steps.content: I... I'm looking for you guys! The FAC has roughly pinpointed the Apostle's location. We can soon proceed with the Sun Shot.

steps.speaker: Nightingale
steps.content: The MBCC is also done deploying the guards. They're ready to assist Chief and the envoys on the operation anytime.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier B
steps.content: The research institute speculates that the Apostle is currently in a dormant state. If needed, we can dispatch unmanned armor to buy you some time... Ambassador Yanyan, why are your eyes so red?
He turns and punches his comrade on the helmet.

steps.speaker: FAC Soldier B
steps.content: Didn't I tell you to treat her nicely? It must be you who made her cry. Apologize now!

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I... I'm alright! Thank you so much, Mr. White Armor, and everyone in the Bureau! I...

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I'm going to rest well, sleep hard, and eat properly, so I can complete the Sun Shot perfectly!
<size=40>One day later</size>

In the late night at the Bureau, Yanyan once again takes out that sketch of the original Almighty Bow and examines it carefully before tucking it back into her pocket. She takes a deep breath and stands in front of you and Du Ruo.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: I'm ready! I've memorized the Sun Shot procedures Du Ruo has taught me! My belly is full, and I've had plenty of sleep! Compass, slingshot, magnifying glass all in place, and also...
She raises the Almighty Bow in her hands high in the air.

steps.speaker: Yanyan
steps.content: With you and everyone from DisCity by Yanyan's side, the Sun Shot must be a huge success tomorrow!
The new engravings on the Almighty Bow emit a faint golden light, shining upon the entire break room with its gentle warmth unlike the scorching sun.
You smile as you bid farewell to everyone, and return to your office by yourself.
The Almighty Bow and the myth are the child's most sincere beliefs. You trust Yanyan's intentions, but the elusive heat inside your body is still warning you.
The Sun Crow is a special and powerful Apostle of Ashes. Can it really be defeated... by such juvenile sorcery and a mere bow?
The Ring Research Institute's analysis report arrives at the MBCC.

BR-002 ruins, Fusang Branch. A substance in between Mania Crystal and Ash Crystal with a significant mental resonance effect. BR-001 ruins, String of East Sea. Another unique Mania creature parasitizing the body of the Sun Crow's kin. While it's virtually non-aggressive toward humans, it has a strong instinct to corrode the Sun Crow. BR-004 ruins, Mystic Fletching. Confirmed to possess some mental characteristics of Mania creatures. A mythological Wraith Spirit that resonates strongly with seers... Is it the Sun Crow's kin, or...

Compared to the Three Calamities seven years ago, the anomalies here are more pronounced. Is it the influence of the Black Rings? I need more information on the Black Rings to confirm the connection between them and the Apostle. I submitted an application through the MBCC, but as expected, it was rejected.
Time is running out...
